name: Frozen channel: weigh the far pad
notes: Reference puzzle for freezing and levitation (mw-e15.9), built with data only: a liquid volume, a pressure plate on the far bank, a crate and a signal latch that raises the portcullis. The goal is the outcome (the far pad is weighed for a second), so a person who crosses and a crate that is lifted across both count. Declared: freeze the surface (a cold stimulus, so any future cold source such as Frostglass, mw-e08.5) and Mage Hand the crate over. Not declared, for gaps the beads below track: floating crates (mw-e03.14, no buoyancy yet), levitating oneself (mw-e08.13) and climbing ceiling beams (ceiling traversal does not exist). Greybox, not story canon.

entities.role: pressure pad on the far bank
a 12 kg crate: light enough for Mage Hand
the portcullis that opens when it is solved

solutions.name: Freeze the surface and walk across

steps.note: Any cold stimulus that reaches the water; no cold source exists in the game yet (Frostglass, mw-e08.5).

solutions.name: Lift the crate across with Mage Hand and set it on the pad

hints.bark: Too deep to wade. Something has to get to that pad.

variants.bark: Nobody said I had to cross it myself.

hints.bark: That crate is not heavy. A weight on the far pad is a weight.

variants.bark: Mage Hand will carry a crate where I cannot.

hints.bark: Cold stops water. Anything that is cold enough will do.

variants.bark: Mage Hand, then. Over the water, set it down gently.
